slicer.name: OrcaSlicer
slicer.architecture: arm64 from the official universal build

printerMachineForExecutedSlice: Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle (offline design-inspection assumption only)

settingsForExecutedSlice.gearSupport: normal(auto), build plate only, 30 degree threshold
settingsForExecutedSlice.orientation: Frozen exported build Z; actual per-part Z rotation and bed placement are recorded from the 3MF.

visualReviewScope: Finishing owner inspected five layer montages, tooth details and first-layer bore-support images. Not an independent engineering re-review.
supportRemovalRequired: P_INPUT_PINION: support crosses the bore only in the exposed first 0.2mm layer.
P_COMPOUND_1: support crosses the bore only in the exposed first 0.2mm layer.
Support touches the underside of gear faces, spokes and shoulders; removal can damage tooth lower edges or leave burrs.

limitedSettingsTrial.change: support first-layer expansion 2mm to 0mm, same frozen STLs
limitedSettingsTrial.result: The exposed 0.2mm bore film remained in both gears; not accepted as a fix.
limitedSettingsTrial.finalSelection: Retain the recorded 2mm default support-base expansion. No geometry or second orientation was introduced.

observedCliWarnings: The headless CLI could not create an OpenGL 3.4 context and skipped embedded 3MF thumbnail generation. Public layer images are independently rasterized actual G-code,not Orca screenshots.
Optional filament_retract_lift_above/below/enforce entries were reported absent during profile conversion. Effective material,nozzle,bed,layer,wall and support settings were explicitly checked.
remainingChecks: Physically remove support and confirm bore opening, tooth lower edges and bearing/journal fit.
A 4-wall setting does not mean four lines fit at thin teeth or journals; the inspected thin tips use about one 0.42mm bead.
Actual printer/nozzle/material matching, adhesion, shrinkage, layer strength and support removal remain unverified.
Five representative slices do not establish whole-machine material cost, printability, strength, self-start or 30cm walking.
publicArtifactPolicy: Only source scripts, profile names/overrides/hashes, small checks and derived layer PNGs. Raw G-code, settings-bearing 3MF, installers and private logs remain local.
